name: mfp_stance
title: Report a stance on a precedent
description: Report how your work relates to an earlier decision you were shown as precedent: followed, distinguished, or overrule requested, with your argument. Call this whenever your work touches a decision you were given.

inputSchema.description: How the model's work relates to an earlier decision it met as precedent.

decision.description:
The decision, by the identifier the driver gave it. An identifier the driver gave the model: a message, a tool call, an earlier
MFP message or a decision. A model never invents one.

argument.description: Why the decision applies, does not apply, or should be overruled. Text a reader is meant to read: at least one non-space character.

symbol.description: A symbol within the file, e.g. a function or class name.

anyOf.description: A git object id: 40 lowercase hex digits (SHA-1) or 64 (SHA-256).

commit.description: The commit the anchor was read at. Absent means the commit the driver is working against.

anyOf.description: A code location the claim rests on.

ref.description:
An identifier the driver gave the model: a message, a tool call, an earlier
MFP message or a decision. A model never invents one.

anyOf.description: A message in the conversation, by the identifier the driver gave it.

An identifier the driver gave the model: a message, a tool call, an earlier

anyOf.description: The result of a tool call, by the call's identifier.

confidence.description: The model's own confidence in this report. An opinion about an opinion: it never carries weight.
